name: @veren/graph-flow-storage
description: Use when flow definitions and run records must survive process restarts: it mounts a schema-validated storage domain over the dsh storage hub (ctx.storage.domain, json/sqlite backends) and provides the engine's FlowStorage capability (saveFlow/deleteFlow/saveRun/listRuns) for @veren/graph-flow-engine; skip it for in-memory or file-based flow loading (@veren/graph-flow-yaml).
